remarks: Your own private oasis in a prime Midcountry location. 739 Lake Avenue blends peaceful private living with easy access to downtown and all that Greenwich has to offer. The classic colonial is set back on 2.3 acres. Inside, the layout flows effortlessly from room to room, ideal for both everyday living and entertaining. Five oversized bedrooms and five and a half baths provide comfortable, flexible space for the whole family, and every detail reflects timeless colonial charm paired with thoughtful livability. A home that has been meticulously cared for throughout the years while keeping gorgeous charm from moldings to archways. Step outside to your own private oasis: a sparkling pool and beautifully landscaped backyard made for long summer days, weekend gatherings, and quiet evenings at home. A cabana bath attached to the house makes pool days effortless, no tracking water through the home required. Just 10 minutes from downtown Greenwich, you get the best of both worlds: peaceful, private living with easy access to town, shops, restaurants, and the train. A rare find, and a true classic Greenwich home.
